name: hcportal_updateKennelHasher
description: Updates a hasher's profile and kennel-specific settings for a given kennel. Allows editing of personal details (name, email, hash name), discount settings, membership status, notification preferences, historical run counts, and historical count estimates. The SP determines which fields to update based on which parameters are non-NULL. All writes are wrapped in a single transaction. 2026-09-23: personal details (@firstName/@lastName/@hashName/@eMail) are refused with Success=0 when the target has signed in (HC.Hasher.LastLoginDateTime set, or any HC.Device row) unless the caller is the target or SuperAdmin; and refused for a never-signed-in target whose HomeKennelId is not the @publicKennelId kennel. @eMail = '<hidden>' (the portal's non-member placeholder) is ignored. 2026-09-24: a non-NULL @eMail already held by another HC.Hasher row (IX_HasherUniqueEmail) is refused before the transaction with Success=0 and 'The email <x> already belongs to <DisplayName>…' — the owner is named only when they hold a HasherKennelMap row in @kennelId, otherwise 'another hasher outside this kennel'. Previously the unique index threw from the CATCH. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @hasherBeingEditedPublicId in the token param string; a regular user (callerType 0) needs AppAccessFlags & 0x40000012 (canManageKennel 0x02 | canManageMembers 0x10 | SuperAdmin) on the kennel — a hard-coded mask, not the Permissions V2 matrix; service accounts skip the permission and ownership checks.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @hasherBeingEditedPublicId as the paramString.

parameters.name: hasherBeingEditedPublicId
parameters.description: Public hasher ID of the user being edited. Required. Also used as the paramString for auth token validation.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Public kennel ID for the kennel context. Required for all kennel-specific updates.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: User's first name. If non-NULL, updates Hasher.FirstName. Widened from NVARCHAR(150) in HC5 to match table column.

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: User's last name. If non-NULL, updates Hasher.LastName. Widened from NVARCHAR(150) in HC5 to match table column.

parameters.name: eMail
parameters.description: New email. '<hidden>' (the portal's placeholder for a non-member) is ignored. Refused when another HC.Hasher already holds it; a changed address resets the email status.

parameters.name: hashName
parameters.description: User's hash name. If non-NULL, updates Hasher.HashName.

parameters.name: isMember
parameters.description: 'yes' sets MembershipExpirationDate to 2999-12-31 (never expires), anything else to yesterday; also sets Following = 1.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) text code for a SMALLINT/INT/DATETIMEOFFSET column (TODO in the SP: proper types when the portal is updated).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: 'member' behaves like @isMember = 'yes'; any other non-NULL value ends membership (yesterday).
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) text code for a SMALLINT/INT/DATETIMEOFFSET column (TODO in the SP: proper types when the portal is updated).

parameters.name: emailAlerts
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) text code for a SMALLINT/INT/DATETIMEOFFSET column (TODO in the SP: proper types when the portal is updated).

parameters.name: notifications
parameters.description: 'on' 1, 'off' 2, 'silver bell' 3, '6 hrs before' 4, 'auto' 0; anything else leaves it.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) text code for a SMALLINT/INT/DATETIMEOFFSET column (TODO in the SP: proper types when the portal is updated).

parameters.name: discountPercent
parameters.description: Discount percentage for the hasher in this kennel. If non-NULL, updates HasherKennelMap.DiscountPercent.

parameters.name: discountAmount
parameters.description: Discount fixed amount for the hasher in this kennel. If non-NULL, updates HasherKennelMap.DiscountAmount.

parameters.name: discountDescription
parameters.description: Description of the discount. If non-NULL, updates HasherKennelMap.DiscountDescription.

parameters.name: historicTotalRuns
parameters.description: Written when ISNUMERIC; then run counts are recalculated and a HistoricalCounts rowset is returned.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) text code for a SMALLINT/INT/DATETIMEOFFSET column (TODO in the SP: proper types when the portal is updated).

parameters.name: historicHaring
parameters.description: Written when ISNUMERIC; then run counts are recalculated and a HistoricalCounts rowset is returned.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) text code for a SMALLINT/INT/DATETIMEOFFSET column (TODO in the SP: proper types when the portal is updated).

parameters.name: historicCountsAreEstimates
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) text code for a SMALLINT/INT/DATETIMEOFFSET column (TODO in the SP: proper types when the portal is updated).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure, missing permission, NULL/unknown hasher or kennel, the personal-details ownership refusals, an email already in use, or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()). On success there is NO envelope: the SP returns nothing unless a historical count was written.

rowsets.name: HistoricalRunCountUpdate
rowsets.description: Returned when @historicTotalRuns is numeric and written (after nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser). Comes first when both counts are given.

columns.name: HistoricalTotalRunCount
columns.description: Historical total run count from HasherKennelMap (just updated)

columns.name: HcTotalRunCount
columns.description: HC system-calculated total run count (recalculated by nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser)

columns.name: hasherBeingEditedId
columns.description: Echo of @hasherBeingEditedPublicId (the PUBLIC id, despite the name)

rowsets.name: HistoricalHaringUpdate
rowsets.description: Returned when @historicHaring is numeric and written (after nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser). Index 0 when it is the only count given, index 1 when @historicTotalRuns was also given.

columns.name: HistoricalHaringCount
columns.description: Historical haring count from HasherKennelMap (just updated)

columns.name: HistoricalTotalRunCount
columns.description: Historical total run count from HasherKennelMap

columns.name: HcTotalRunCount
columns.description: HC system-calculated total run count (recalculated by nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser)

columns.name: hasherBeingEditedId
columns.description: Echo of @hasherBeingEditedPublicId (the PUBLIC id, despite the name)

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher (Email, FirstName, LastName, HashName, updatedAt) when any of those are non-NULL; EXEC HC6.nonApi_resetEmailStatus when the address changed
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap discounts (DiscountAmount, DiscountPercent, DiscountDescription), then EXEC HC6.nonApi_syncMemberStandingBit
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap MembershipExpirationDate (2999-12-31 or yesterday) and Following = 1 when @isMember or @status is given
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap KennelNotificationPreference / KennelEmailAlertPreference / HistoricalCountIsEstimate / HistoricalTotalRunCount / HistoricalHaringCount as given
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser after either historical count is written
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning

Never change the string values for @isMember ('yes'), @status ('member'), @emailAlerts ('on'/'off'/'auto'), @notifications ('on'/'off'/'silver bell'/'6 hrs before'/'auto'), @historicCountsAreEstimates ('yes'/'no') without updating all callers
Never change the '2999-12-31' never-expires sentinel date without updating all callers

codeSmells.issue: Member standing bit synced in the wrong branch
codeSmells.detail: Lines 260-265 call HC6.nonApi_syncMemberStandingBit inside the DISCOUNT block, with a comment saying it keeps the MEMBER bit in sync 'with the expiration just written'. The membership block (lines 269-283), which is what writes MembershipExpirationDate, never calls it, so making someone a member or ending membership here leaves KennelStanding 0x0001 stale until the sweep runs.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 408-411: CATCH rolls back and returns the envelope with no HC.ErrorLog row.
Lines 339-341 and 372-374: ISNUMERIC accepts '1.5', '$', '1e3'; CAST(... AS INT) then throws and the whole edit rolls back with a raw conversion message. TRY_CAST would skip it cleanly.
A successful edit with no historical count returns no rowset at all; the client infers success from the absence of an error.

codeSmells.issue: Hard-coded flag mask and service-account bypass
codeSmells.detail: Line 100 gates on AppAccessFlags & 0x40000012 rather than HC6.CheckKennelPermission (mismanagement roles cannot grant it), and lines 91-105 / 157 skip both the permission and the ownership checks for callerType != 0.
